name: The Rose (Alison Benson) (Tzimisce, Bishop of Montreal, the Widows)

system.concept: Sensation-starved Tzimisce sculptor of flesh, leader of the Cathari coven the Widows and a bishop of Montreal
system.title: Bishop of Montreal
system.biography:
Background

Alison Benson, a childhood victim of sexual abuse, grew up with a psychosomatic condition that left her unable to feel touch, taste, or smell, experiencing life as a distant, hollow dream. Her search for sensation led through self-mutilation, drugs, S&M and eventually torture and murder; she was Embraced by an unknown sire on the night before her sentencing for killing five lovers, and tore her own sire apart in ecstatic frenzy upon rising, savoring physical sensation for the first time. She rebuilt the burned-out lair of Montreal's original Cathari coven, the Widows, in the late 1950s, using the flesh of lured victims, and now leads the reborn coven from "The Heart," Montreal's most notorious den of dark pleasure. She was named the city's third bishop under Archbishop Sangris.

Roleplaying Hints

You are neither man nor woman but both, using your androgyny to keep others off balance. Your voice fluctuates from male to female and is known to leave @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.GaCuLGcjZZjf2EO6]{Toreador} antitribu transfixed. Only passion, desire, experience and degradation matter to you.

Secrets

The Rose and the Widows know a great deal of what happens in Montreal, learned largely from the Shepherds who visit them on their dark cycles.
system.notes: Embraced 1957. Apparent age: early 20s. Uses Vicissitude on herself constantly, never appearing quite the same twice. @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.paths-of-enlightenment.JournalEntry.exke2riW9D0htoUu]{Path of Cathari} 10. Disciplines (as printed): Auspex 4, Celerity 2, Dominate 4, Presence 5, Vicissitude 5.

system.description: Spend three Blood Traits and 10 minutes to extrude a tough, fibrous cocoon around yourself that blocks sunlight and negates the first two health levels of fire damage per turn. Attackers must defeat the cocoon's strength in a Static Physical Challenge against twice your Physical Traits before striking you. You may use mental Disciplines while cocooned if their requirements can otherwise be met, and may emerge at no cost at any time.

Permanently converts your vitae into organic acid. Any Blood Trait that contacts something other than you inflicts two levels of aggravated damage; anyone drinking your vitae takes four levels of aggravated damage per Blood Trait. When a penetrating attack injures you in close combat, make a Simple Test; on a win, you lose one Blood Trait that sprays toward your attacker, who must win a Static Physical Challenge (difficulty five) or take one level of aggravated damage. Objects piercing you corrode away within minutes, and stakes dissolve within five turns.

Named for the legendary (and supposedly fae) progenitor of the houses of Anjou and Lusignan, this power lets a Toreador sway others through song. If the Artisan can phrase her request in the form of a song, her words take on the weight of a nigh-irresistible command.

System: The player states the suggestion she wishes to weave into the song and describes the song's nature. Everyone within earshot must resist or unknowingly submit to the request. The effect lasts as long as the Toreador continues singing or until the target leaves her presence; commands requiring the victim to leave the singer's presence can be resisted once more after the enchanting voice fades. Listeners outside the Toreador's immediate presence may notice something odd about the performance, though it registers as little more than an exceptionally fine one; other Toreador within earshot are immediately entranced. As a side benefit, knowledge of this power makes the character a superlative singer even when the power itself is not invoked.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis II: Keepers of the Word, Book One: Artisans (Toreador)
system.duration: As long as the Toreador continues singing, or until the target leaves her presence

items.name: Presence — 3 Advanced — Pulse of the City

system.description: Your emotional state is always passively mirrored by the population of an entire city-sized region, with visitors affected less strongly than residents and vampires affected one level more mildly than mortals. To deliberately project a chosen emotion, spend a Willpower Trait and win a Static Social Challenge (typically 10-15 Traits, Storyteller's call) to shift the city's mood for one minute, extendable by spending additional Social Traits before the challenge. Two Methuselahs with this power contesting the same city test the Social Challenge directly against one another, with the longer-established Methuselah (six months or more) gaining five bonus Traits. Usable even while in torpor.
system.bloodCost: One Willpower Trait (plus Social Traits to extend duration)
system.duration: One minute per activation, longer with extra Social Traits spent

system.description: Rather than requiring eye contact, you may use Dominate through skin-to-skin contact alone (a Physical Challenge may be needed on unwilling subjects). The touch need not be maintained while issuing the command, but only one command may be given per contact; using Dominate again requires touching the subject anew.

Originally used to lead warrior-caste mystics on vision quests, this vizier technique lets a willing seer bring companions with him into the astral realms. All would-be participants must form an unbroken chain of physical contact with the character. Spend a Blood Trait for each "follower" you wish to bring along, up to a maximum of half your permanent Mental Traits (rounded down), then leave your body as per Psychic Projection. Each follower is treated as though she knows Psychic Projection regardless of her actual Auspex rating, using the leader's rolled successes. On the astral plane, followers must remain within roughly 100 feet of the leader, tethered to him and unable to break the connection. Any follower who loses physical contact with the leader instantly returns to her body and loses three Mental Traits, falling unconscious for the rest of the night if this reduces her to zero Mental Traits.
system.bloodCost: 1 Blood Trait per follower (max half permanent Mental Traits, rounded down)

vtmlarp.source: Montreal by Night, Chapter Five: Covens
